## 2. THE THREE THINGS THAT MATTER MOST

**(a) The negative control was the agonist.** `NEG_nonbinder` is 81% mature human EGF (43/53
residues verbatim, all six cysteines in order). Every bar in this project was calibrated
against it. Per PK it is now **activity-unknown**, not "a binder" — the similarity stops us
calling it a nonbinder but does not establish it retains EGF's affinity. The 0.1493/0.2218
hard gates are **RETIRED**; affinity is a continuous reported column with an
`affinity_above_null` flag. `MIN_AFFINITY = None` in `bin/emit_submission_csv.py`.
EGF's own measured KD on this platform is **55 nM median** (not the ~2 nM I wrote to PK).

**(b) BindCraft beats BoltzGen on every axis, and we gave it 11 invocations vs 1,944 designs.**
  dual-species binding   50% vs 3.5%
  Potts pH distribution  median +1.60 vs +2.90
  QC                     GRAVY -0.52..-1.37 (all clean) vs +0.10..+0.24
  71 BindCraft designs were recovered off the Modal volume on Oct 4 having never been scored;
  18 of them switch AND bind both species. Rank 3 came from that recovery.
  `bin/bindcraft-sync.sh` now pulls everything off the volume. RUN IT AFTER EVERY BindCraft JOB.

**(c) One mutation converts a binder into a switch.** `d2c_mpnn13` WT = 0.70x; S88D = 4.57x
over 5 poses; knock the Asp back to Ala = 0.72x. Knockout effect **+5.20 pKa units**, the
largest in the project. That is rank 2, and it is the only *engineered* design in the file.

## 3. DECISIONS ALREADY MADE — do not relitigate

- **One submission, made LATE** (target Mon evening). Not three. Mooted the 24h-cooldown rule.
- **Mouse dropped as a tier-2 sort key.** Anthropic says mouse is measured at pH 7.4 only, so a
  design that switches off at 7.4 has an undefined mouse/human ratio. Tier 2 sorts by human.
  The meaningful mouse criterion is whether the switching histidine is conserved (H433 yes).
- **Mosaic stays gated** for problems 2-5; Proton-PottsMPNN took over its rationale.
- **Git remote deferred to submission time.** IT IS A REQUIRED DELIVERABLE AND DOES NOT EXIST.
- **S88D replaces its parent** `d2c_mpnn13` (99.3% identical); mpnn11 is one of 12 sequences on
  one backbone = **one sequence family, one slot**.

## 5. TOOLING YOU WILL NEED

    bin/ph_gate_all.py          pH gate, all designs, generator poses (1,944 rows)
    bin/ph_gate_refolds.py      pH gate on ESMFold2 refolds -- THE ONE THAT COUNTS
    bin/instrument_v2.py        ipSAE_min, v1 max / v2 median over seeds
    bin/emit_submission_csv.py  builds the CSV; selftest must pass
    bin/check_discards.py       hard gate: nothing unmeasured may outrank a submitted design
    bin/bindcraft-sync.sh       pull BindCraft output off the Modal volume
    bin/novelty_gate.py         FOLDSEEK=tools/foldseek/bin/foldseek ... --db tools/fsdb/pdb

**Proton-PottsMPNN** (third pH predictor, local CPU):
    HBPLUS_PATH=/tmp/HBPLUS/hbplus/hbplus DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib \
      /tmp/ProtonPottsMPNN/.venv/bin/python /tmp/ppm_batch.py <list.txt> <out.csv>
  `/tmp` IS NOT PERSISTENT. Rebuild: clone github.com/christian-creator/ProtonPottsMPNN,
  `./install.sh`, and build HBPLUS from github.com/RomanLas/HBPLUS (`make` in `hbplus/`).

**Standing traps, all of which have bitten:**
  - zsh does NOT word-split unquoted variables (broke 3 scripts)
  - chain order is NOT consistent: 29 of 69 run dirs have the TARGET in chain A. Use
    `ph_gate_all.orient()`. This has broken 3 separate analyses.
  - construct numbering differs: crop H433=123, d3 H433=99, ECD H433=409. UniProt = PDB + 24.
  - `python3` has gemmi+propka; `.venv` has numpy but NOT gemmi
  - ProcessPoolExecutor cannot fork from a heredoc -- write a real .py file
  - score-esmfold2.sh cd's into biomodals/, so OUT_DIR must start `../`
